mapper.select: SELECT s.step_id, s.step_order, s.step_name, s.approval_type, s.target_department_type, s.target_department_id, o.name AS target_department_name, s.target_role_key, s.target_user_id, u.name AS target_user_name, s.group_approval_yn, s.required_yn FROM approval_line_template_step s LEFT JOIN orgs o ON o.org_id = s.target_department_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.target_user_id WHERE s.template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY s.step_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_line_template_step ( template_id, step_order, step_name, approval_type, target_department_type, target_department_id, target_role_key, target_user_id, group_approval_yn, required_yn ) VALUES ( #{templateId}, #{s.stepOrder}, #{s.stepName}, COALESCE(#{s.approvalType}, 'APPROVE'), #{s.targetDepartmentType}, #{s.targetDepartmentId}, #{s.targetRoleKey}, #{s.targetUserId}, COALESCE(#{s.groupApprovalYn}, TRUE), COALESCE(#{s.requiredYn}, TRUE) )
